verdict.rationale: LangSmith has an official MCP server and a versioned public REST API with an OpenAPI spec, and the docs say traces can be filtered and exported via the API, including a thread-query endpoint. That gives an agent a documented programmatic path into trace data. The evidence does not show which tools the MCP server exposes, or that metrics, dashboards or evaluation/experiment results can be queried through the API or MCP. missing for 10: documented MCP tool coverage for traces/metrics/evals, explicit API access to metrics and eval/experiment results, hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app

citations.quote: Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.
The LangSmith API is used to programmatically create and manage LangSmith resources
